notes.title: First major update in 4 years
notes.content:
Added:
6 new music tracks.
Replaced music in the main menu.

Added level system.
-When you kill bots, you will receive experience that will increase your characteristics.

The easy difficulty level has been reworked.
-Reduced HP of some bots

Reworked HUD
-Added level display
-Added numerical display of HP amount
-Added Timer. So you can brag to your friends that you were able to hold out for more than a minute
-Changed HUD color for better perception

notes.title: New Year update
notes.content:
New New Year's event.
New map with a winter location

notes.title: Update 0.1
notes.content:
patch 1 
-Add new map
-Add new monster

-Fix AI
-Fix water bug. monsters did not see the player in the water
-Fix bug with management. when pressing turn the character turns regardless of the direction of the mouse fixed
-Fix weapon:
Blaster damag changed from 6 to 10
Bls-ZC2 changed the rate of fire from 1 to 0.6
Ultra-KB35 changed the rate of fire from 0.05 to 0.1
ZRX changed the rate of fire from 0.5 to 0.3
